en: Colorized view along a riverside promenade with a railing and trees on the left and a calm river flowing through a European city. On the opposite bank stand rows of historic buildings with red-tiled roofs and a church tower topped with an onion-shaped dome. A metal truss bridge spans the river. Behind the city rises a steep, green hill crowned by fortifications and walls; on the right side of the hill is a prominent clock tower with a large clock face and wooden roof. The image has the look of an early 20th‑century printed postcard.
